review_question: In children with PFAPA syndrome, does tonsillectomy, with or without adenoidectomy, compared with non-surgical management reduce PFAPA symptoms and episode frequency?

population.description: Children with periodic fever, aphthous stomatitis, pharyngitis and cervical adenitis (PFAPA) syndrome

outcome.description: Immediate and persistent resolution of PFAPA symptoms

timepoint_policy.rule: Preserve each eligible source-reported randomized follow-up timepoint

targets.effect_selection_rule: Prefer exact randomized arm counts when the source report makes them recoverable.

field_definitions.intervention_events: Number of analyzed participants in the intervention arm with the target outcome during the source-defined follow-up.
field_definitions.intervention_total: Number of analyzed participants in the intervention arm for the target outcome.
field_definitions.control_events: Number of analyzed participants in the comparator arm with the target outcome during the source-defined follow-up.
field_definitions.control_total: Number of analyzed participants in the comparator arm for the target outcome.

extraction_notes: Preserve the source definition of resolution and its follow-up window.

outcome.description: PFAPA episode frequency or rate during randomized follow-up

timepoint_policy.rule: Preserve the complete randomized follow-up interval reported by each source

targets.effect_selection_rule: Preserve source-reported event counts, arm sizes, follow-up, and person-time or rates when available.

field_definitions.intervention_episodes: Total number of target events accrued by all analyzed participants in the intervention arm during the source-defined follow-up.
field_definitions.intervention_total: Number of analyzed participants in the intervention arm contributing the stated follow-up.
field_definitions.control_episodes: Total number of target events accrued by all analyzed participants in the comparator arm during the source-defined follow-up.
field_definitions.control_total: Number of analyzed participants in the comparator arm contributing the stated follow-up.
field_definitions.follow_up_months: Duration in months of the source-defined follow-up shared by the analyzed arm participants.
field_definitions.reported_rates_per_person_month: Source-reported arm-specific event rates per person-month, only when explicitly printed.

derivation_preconditions: the stated follow-up applies to all analyzed participants
the source reports no loss of follow-up or otherwise confirms complete follow-up
derivation_instructions: When the preconditions are met, retain exact arm-level event totals, participant totals, and follow-up even when the source does not print a rate or person-time; downstream may derive person-time from participant total multiplied by follow-up.
source_aggregation_rules: When a source states that N participants each experienced M target events, record the arm total as N multiplied by M rather than M alone.

targets.effect_selection_rule: Do not reconstruct exact arm counts from rounded percentages.

field_definitions.intervention_events: Number of analyzed intervention-arm participants with the target outcome during the source-defined follow-up, when exact source counts are reported.
field_definitions.intervention_total: Number of analyzed intervention-arm participants for the target outcome, when exact source counts are reported.
field_definitions.control_events: Number of analyzed comparator-arm participants with the target outcome during the source-defined follow-up, when exact source counts are reported.
field_definitions.control_total: Number of analyzed comparator-arm participants for the target outcome, when exact source counts are reported.
